concurrencyProof.frontend: Two simultaneous local reversal attempts produce one success, one refusal, one correction, one audit and one REVERSE_PAYMENT outbox operation.
concurrencyProof.backend: Two simultaneous reversal requests produce HTTP 200/409, one reversal ledger row, one required audit and an exactly restored balance.
concurrencyProof.productionLock: The backend acquires the existing PostgreSQL customer-balance row lock before reading reversal state.

mobileAndStatementQa.paymentTask: Phone payment capture uses the shared full-screen task contract below 640px, 48px money/mode inputs and a sticky safe-area action footer.
mobileAndStatementQa.touchTargets: Customer payment shortcuts, tender modes, profile actions, ledger menus, receipt and reversal actions are pinned to at least 44px by source regression coverage.
mobileAndStatementQa.statement: Both statement generators escape customer/ledger text, interpolate translated headings and delay printing until layout is ready.
mobileAndStatementQa.receipt: Each payment exposes a printable receipt with amount, mode, date, reference and current balance; reversed payments are visibly marked and retained for audit history.
mobileAndStatementQa.freshAuthenticatedScreenCapture: not claimed; the available browser session required credential/PIN entry and no security bypass was used

scope: Local correctness and production-readiness evidence. It does not claim an exact-candidate CI run, a fresh authenticated mobile screenshot, external deployment or human release approval.
